_comment: Desired Handy settings, applied by `scripts/omarchy.sh restore` (configure_handy).
Keys starting with _ are ignored. Values are written while Handy is stopped:
its tauri store caches settings in memory and would clobber a live edit.
paste_method=ctrl_v (not the Linux default 'direct'): 'direct' makes Handy
type every character with wtype, and VS Code's editor drops keystrokes doing
that (Chrome/Obsidian were fine). Clipboard + one Ctrl+V is byte-perfect.
See the Handy notes in README.md.
keeps the recording pill; hyprland.lua pins it with no_focus so it cannot
steal focus and swallow the pasted transcript.
